about: Per-model corrections; see system/DeviceProfile.kt. Entries match on ro.product.model, first match wins. buildMajorBelow: only while the first number of Build.DISPLAY is below it. Inputs are keyed by hardware id (.../HW5 is 5). A TV's own profile (Control Center input check, or ConfigReceiver device_profile) has the same fields and replaces its entry.

profiles.note: Novatek, firmware 22.7.26.1365: real input sessions map 23/24/25 to HW6/5/4 (#563).
Registers a fourth HDMI input (HW8) with no connector behind it; tuners named by what they receive. Maintainer's TV.

Redmi monitor G Pro 27U registers its DP port (HW9) and USB-C port (HW10) both as DisplayPort; tvplayer sources 29 and 30 (#62, its MonitorUtils). It also registers two tuners (HW0, HW1, reported connected) and a composite input (HW2) that a monitor does not have (#815; the same on the owner's MFFU1, OS3.0.120). The 2025 model has no USB-C either, but it shares the model name with the 2026 one, so HW10 stays.
L42R7-RA, Amlogic, Android 5.1: one HDMI input, HW6, labelled HDMI2, is the HDMI 1 port and source 23 (#64, reporter's logcat).

Mi TV 4, firmware 22.8 and later: the port droidlogic registers as Hdmi3InputService/HW7 is the one tvplayer calls HDMI 1, source 23 (22.8.15.3312 #592, 22.11.18.3386 #584, 22.11.28.3390 #514); 22.4.15 still follows hw + 18 (#375). HW6/HW5 as 24/25 is the same order turned round, not yet seen.

Mi TV 4, Amlogic, Android 6.0.1, older firmwares: HW7 is source 23 on some boards (#191, #313) and 25 on others (#492), which hdmi3_order tells apart; 23 is the fallback. Firmware 22.x follows the general rule (#375).
77" OLED, mt9950, Android 9: HW4-HW7 registered as HDMI 1-4, but three ports; HW7 has none, tvplayer numbers them hw + 19 (#311, reporter's local build).
Android 9: has picture_backlight, yet changing it leaves the panel as it was (#284, #335).
Android 9, m7332: the TV's menu writes picture_backlight (100 to 15), Aerial's write leaves the panel as it was; backLightForNormal is kept, so the mitv panel path is probed instead (#1014).

Coocaa (Tianci, MStar maserati, Android 6): screen_brightness moves mActualBacklight but not the panel; the backlight is in com.tianci.setting's picture page (#895, the owner watched the TV; 6S58_K6S, Android 6, the same, slider 5 -> 95 changed nothing).
Whaley (Helios, Android 5.0.2): the power light breathes after a cold boot until the stock launcher has been on screen once (#902, the reporter's adb test).
